scripts.install:all: npm --prefix hyperframes install && npm --prefix remotion install
scripts.render:bg: cd hyperframes/bg && npx hyperframes render -f 30 -q high -o ../../remotion/public/hyperframes-bg.mp4
scripts.render:video: cd remotion && npx remotion render Aufruf1111 out/aufruf-1111.mp4
scripts.render: npm run render:bg && npm run render:video && npm run render:photo && npm run render:gemeinsam && npm run render:dance && npm run render:tanz && npm run render:traum && npm run render:zweifel
scripts.render:photo: cd hyperframes/photo && npx hyperframes render -f 30 -q high -o ../../remotion/public/hyperframes-photo.mp4
scripts.render:gemeinsam: cd remotion && npx remotion render GemeinsamWachsen out/gemeinsam-wachsen.mp4
scripts.render:dance: cd hyperframes/dance && npx hyperframes render -f 30 -q high -o ../../remotion/public/hyperframes-dance.mp4
scripts.render:tanz: python3 remotion/scripts/beat.py remotion/public/beat.wav && cd remotion && npx remotion render TanzVideo out/tanz-video.mp4
scripts.render:traum: cd hyperframes/traum && npx hyperframes render -f 30 -q high -o ../../remotion/public/hyperframes-traum.mp4
scripts.render:zweifel: cd remotion && npx remotion render ZweifelTraum out/zweifel-traum.mp4
